HpId.description: Exact Human Phenotype Ontology identifier with seven decimal digits.

x-enum-descriptions: Native direct parent and child links.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Read an exact HP term from HPO or Monarch, or page native source sections. A term lookup answers terminology; an association answers what its publisher asserts. Neither establishes a diagnosis.

section.description: Absent means the source identity card.

section_limit.description: Default five text/link rows or one complete association row.

snapshot.description: Retained exact source reply for local text and link pages; unsupported for diseases and genes.

source.description: HPO or Monarch for cards, synonyms and xrefs; Monarch only for hierarchy, diseases and genes. Defaults to HPO for cards, synonyms and xrefs, otherwise Monarch.

title: PhenotypeGet
